note: The keeper's own pages (docs/future/13 section 2.4), written in the walker's hand and kept in the journal: the first opens by itself at the spring on the first evening. Each is { id, form, title, body: [lines] } in the letters' light markup (src/ui/journal-letters.js); an empty line starts a new paragraph. Under 60 words each. The first page's text is a stand-in until the story collaborator's arrives.

words.entryLine: In your own hand, from the morning you came.
words.title: Keeper's pages

pages.title: The first page
body: I came in on the morning tide. The land here is new, still pale from the sea.
Keepers don't own the islands we tend. We help them hold what comes, and write down what we see.
Someone will read this after me. Start at the spring.
